title: Command
description: A searchable command palette in a modal. Type to filter by title, description, group and keywords, move with the arrow keys, choose with Enter or a click. An optional global shortcut opens it.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; leave `undefined` for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state while uncontrolled

props.name: items
props.description: Commands to search. Disabled items are never shown.

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the dialog; defaults to the localized "Command palette".

props.name: description
props.description: Accessible description of the palette; defaults to a localized hint.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the search input; defaults to a localized hint.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when nothing matches; defaults to the localized "No matching results".

props.name: shortcutLabel
props.description: Shortcut hint rendered as `<kbd>` next to the title, e.g. "⌘K".

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Global keyboard shortcut(s) that open the palette, e.g. "mod+k" (Cmd+K on macOS, Ctrl+K elsewhere). Modifiers: mod, ctrl, meta/cmd, shift, alt/option.

props.name: maxResults
props.description: Maximum number of results shown

props.name: filter
props.description: Custom search, e.g. to rank results by match quality. Receives the enabled items and the trimmed query (never empty) and returns the matching items in display order (then capped at `maxResults`). By default, items whose group, title, description or keywords contain the query (case-insensitive) are kept in `items` order.

props.name: resultsLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the results list; defaults to the localized "Command results".

props.name: enterLabel
props.description: Key hint shown at the end of the search input; defaults to the localized "Enter".

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Called with the requested open state (shortcut, selection, Escape, overlay click).

events.name: onSelect
events.description: Called with the chosen item (click or Enter); the dialog then closes.

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Controlled palette; onSelect receives the chosen item and the palette closes.

examples.title: Ranked results
examples.description: filter replaces the default substring search: it receives the enabled items and the trimmed query and returns the results in display order. Here, titles starting with the query come first.

examples.title: Global shortcut
examples.description: shortcut="mod+k" opens the palette with Cmd+K on macOS and Ctrl+K elsewhere; shortcutLabel shows the hint.

examples.title: Site search
examples.description: The documentation search composes Button and CommandDialog: filtering, groups, empty results, keyboard selection and focus restoration. This example uses Ctrl+Shift+K; the site uses Cmd/Ctrl+K. Connect onSelect to your router in an application.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: items is a JS property (id, title, description, group, keywords, disabled). Type to filter, move with the arrow keys, choose with Enter or a click; minerva-select gives the chosen id.

shortcut.title: Global shortcut
shortcut.description: shortcut takes a comma-separated list ("mod+k, /"; mod is Ctrl, or ⌘ on macOS) and opens the palette from anywhere, except while typing in a field. max-results caps the list.

custom-filter.title: Ranked results
custom-filter.description: filter replaces the default substring search: it receives the enabled items and the trimmed query and returns the results in display order. Here, titles starting with the query come first.

props.label: Title of the dialog (default: localized "Command palette").

events.minerva-select: A command was chosen (detail: { value, item }, value = the item's id); the palette then closes.
events.minerva-open-change: The user asked to open (shortcut) / close (detail: { open, reason }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.
events.minerva-after-open: The palette is open and focus moved to the search input.
events.minerva-after-close: Fired once the panel has finished closing (after its exit animation).

cssVars.--modal-width: Width of the panel (defaults to the width of the size, capped by the viewport).
cssVars.--modal-max-height: Maximum height of the panel (the body scrolls beyond).
cssVars.--modal-padding: Horizontal padding of the header, description, body and footer.
cssVars.--modal-radius: Corner radius of the panel (defaults to --radius-xl).
cssVars.--modal-z-index: Stacking order of the panel (defaults to --z-modal).
